items.actClause: AN ACT to amend chapter 899 of the laws of 1984, relating to the creation of a public benefit corporation to plan, develop, operate, maintain and manage Roosevelt Island, in relation to the management of such corporation
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S5813

TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend chapter 899 of the laws of 1984, relating to the
creation of a public benefit corporation to plan, develop, operate,
maintain and manage Roosevelt Island, in relation to the management of
such corporation

PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

Clarifies that Roosevelt Island Operating Corporation (RIOC) board has
the authority to distribute public purpose funds.

SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

This bill:

*Clarifies RIOC Board's authority to provided financial assistance in
the form of grants to not-for-profit corporations or governmental
agencies that provide direct services to the residents of RI.

*Limits RIOC Board's authority to provide financial assistance to 1%
of its operating budget.

*Requires approval of a majority of the RIOC board.

*Takes effect immediately.

JUSTIFICATION:

The Roosevelt Island Public Purpose Fund program started in 1989. The
RIOC Board distributed funds for capital improvements and other RI
needs at its discretion provided that the funds were not used to pay
RIOC operating expenses. Since 2008-2009, the RI Youth Program and
other community non-profits were line items in RIOC's budget. In
January 2015, the Authorities Budget Office issued a policy guidance
which created confusion as to whether this longstanding practice could
continue. This legislation clarifies that the RIOC Board can continue
to distribute the public purpose funds.

PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

None

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None

EFFECTIVE DATE:

Immediately.

A.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S5813A         REVISED MEMO 06/09/2015

TITLE OF BILL:  An act to amend chapter 899 of the laws of 1984,
relating to the creation of a public benefit corporation to plan,
develop, operate, maintain and manage Roosevelt Island, in relation to
the management of such corporation; and providing for the repeal of
such provisions upon expiration thereof

PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

Clarifies that Roosevelt Island Operating Corporation (RIOC) board has
the authority to distribute public purpose funds.

SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

This bill:

*States the legislative intent to allow the RIOC Board to distribute
public purpose funds to not-for-profit organizations.
*Clarifies RIOC Board's authority to provide financial assistance in
the form of grants to not-for-profit corporations or governmental
agencies that provide direct services to the residents of RI.
*Limits RIOC Board's authority to provide financial assistance to 3%
of its operating budget.
*Requires a formal resolution approving grants by a majority of the
RIOC board.
*Requires RIOC to post a public report detailing all grants from
2010-2015.
*Takes effect immediately.
*Sunsets on December 31, 2016.

JUSTIFICATION:

The Roosevelt Island Public Purpose Fund program started in 1989. The
RIOC Board distributed funds for capital improvements and other RI
needs at its discretion provided that the funds were not used to pay
RIOC operating expenses. Since 2008-2009, the RI Youth Program and
other community non-profits were line items in RIOC's budget. During
that time span, grants from RIOC have enabled established non-profits
to help improve the health, education and culture of Roosevelt Island.

In January 2015, the Authorities Budget Office issued a broad policy
guideline (No. 15-01) which applied to the grant making ability of all
state and local authorities. Incidentally, this change has created
ambiguity as to whether RIOC's longstanding practice of providing
public purpose grants can continue. This legislation simply clarifies
that the RIOC Board can continue to distribute the public purpose
funds which are essential to Roosevelt Island.

PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

None

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None


EFFECTIVE DATE:

Immediately.

B.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S5813B

TITLE OF BILL:  An act to amend chapter 899 of the laws of 1984,
relating to the creation of a public benefit corporation to plan,
develop, operate, maintain and manage Roosevelt Island, in relation to
the management of such corporation; to amend the public authorities
law, in relation to the management of the Roosevelt Island operating
corporation; and providing for the repeal of such provisions upon
expiration thereof

PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL: Authorizes the Roosevelt Island
Operating Corporation (RIOC) to distribute public purpose funds.

SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS: This bill would:

*clarify RIOC Board's authority to provided financial assistance in
the form of grants to not-for-profit corporations or governmental
agencies that provide direct services or benefits to the residents of
Roosevelt Island.

*limit RIOC Board's authority to provide financial assistance to 3% of
its operating budget.

*require approval of a majority of the RIOC board to issue the funds.

*require a report on grants issued from 2010-2015.

*take effect immediately and expires on December 31, 2016.

JUSTIFICATION: The Roosevelt Island Public Purpose Fund program was
created in 1989 by the Roosevelt Island Operating Corporation. These
funds are currently distributed by the Corporation to not-for-profit
community organizations whose purpose is to benefit Roosevelt Island
residents by enhancing their quality of life through education,
artistic and cultural enrichment, improved health or a better
environment. In January 2015, the Authorities Budget Office issued a
policy guidance which explained that public benefit corporations must
have explicit statutory authorization in order to issue grants. This
legislation would comply with the policy guidance and authorize the
Corporation to continue to distribute public purpose funds.

PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY: None

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS: None

EFFECTIVE DATE: Immediately and expires on December 31, 2016.

approvalMessage.text:
APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 13 Chapter 517

       MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 5813-B, entitled:

    "AN  ACT  to  amend chapter 899 of the laws of 1984, relating to the
        creation of a public benefit corporation to plan, develop, oper-
        ate, maintain and manage Roosevelt Island, in  relation  to  the
        management  of such corporation; to amend the public authorities
        law, in relation to the management of the Roosevelt Island oper-
        ating  corporation;  and  providing  for  the  repeal  of   such
        provisions upon expiration thereof"

    APPROVED

  This  bill  clarifies and confirms that the Roosevelt Island Operating
Corporation (RIOC) is expressly authorized to issue grants  to  not-for-
profit  corporations  that provide direct services or benefits to Roose-
velt Island residents. While the intent of the bill is clear, as  draft-
ed, there are technical flaws that must be corrected to ensure there are
no  barriers to successful implementation. The Legislature has agreed to
enact legislation that would address these concerns, and on that  basis,
I am signing this bill.

  This bill is approved.                      (signed) ANDREW M. CUOMO

                                ______

summary: Authorizes the Roosevelt Island operating corporation board of directors to provide financial assistance in the form of grants to not-for-profit organizations that provide services to residents.
